tools.name: lookup_part

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find BIDON part pages whose part number contains the given text (at least 3 letters or digits, separators ignored), e.g. "LRS-150" or "B0505". Use it when the exact part number is unknown, then call lookup_part.
